snippet.title: Void Martyrs - Official Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
The FGS Live From gamescom latam showcase debuted a new trailer for Void Martyrs, a top down horror shooter being created by a team comprising (among others) former Cyberpunk 2077 art leads. It revealed a first glimpse of the main character’s backstory and announced a demo coming in summer 2025. Void Martyrs is a grimdark survival horror about a nun in a space suit. Scavenge amongst drifting space cathedrals, balance your faith with survival, and craft the tools of your salvation. Coming to PC. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #gamescomlatam
